The casing helps to reduce damage

He draws a lot of cards, it should be no problem to get some of the mentioned cards.

posts.name: FearLord
posts.cooked:
I suppose he can be a little on the fragile side, but I’m usually pretty careful to try and protect him - his damage potential is pretty great. 

The Casing is a great defensive card though...

Vitality Battery can also be pretty great if you’re in a target heavy fight. 

I think you need to concentrate on his health though, as while he has ways of mitigating damage and healing, a lot of his effects are self damaging, and if he’s taking a lot of hits, Cosmic Immolation can come back to bite him, so he needs balance between getting the most out of his offence while keeping himself alive.

I’ve really enjoyed using him so far though.
